arStrings.szText: Take reduced damage while Wall of Agony is active

When {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} expires, demon brutes remain for {c_number}{SF_8}{/c} seconds and attack Nearby enemies. If {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} is killed early then the demon brutes gain its remaining duration.
{c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} summons {c_number}[{SF_15}*2]{/c} demons in a cage formation that Pulls enemies inward.

{c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} is summoned in an encircling formation that Knocks enemies Back. Each active {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} demon grants you {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction, up to {c_number}[{SF_26}*{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c}. {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} now has a {c_number}[{SF_27}]{/c} second Cooldown but costs no Dominance.
Each hit from {c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|%|]{/c} chance to Knock Down enemies for {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Wall of Agony's{/c} cost is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|%|]{/c} but increased by {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c} for every Demon you have active.
{c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|x1%|]{/c} increased damage for every point of Dominance you have.
{c_important}Wall of Agony{/c} now only spawns {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} demons but its cost is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_24}*100|%|]{/c}.
